prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1328; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Our client has been advised to seek and follow appropriate medical care, and the resulting treatment and related losses will be documented as they develop.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a declaration of any other coverage that may apply to this loss. Please also confirm the name of the adjuster assigned to the claim so that we may coordinate with that individual going forward.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, statements, claim notes, recorded calls, repair estimates, and any surveillance or dashcam footage. Please treat this letter as formal notice of our expectation that all such materials be retained in their current form until this matter is resolved.
